title: Demoted!! What To Do Now??
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2026-02-11

Opens [Sir 2](/bible/sirach/2) · [1 Sam 18](/bible/1-samuel/18) · [2 Cor 13](/bible/2-corinthians/13) · [Ps 75](/bible/psalms/75) · [1 Cor 15](/bible/1-corinthians/15)
## Introduction *[[0:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=13s)]* Shalom. Most high in Christ bless you. I'm Captain Tobias and this is another 15 minutes with a captain. So the thumbnail is demoted, what to do now? A lot of the men in rank has fallen, has done things or whatever. House is out of order. You may have not done much, but your house is out of order. Something happened to where you got demoted. ## Scriptures Opened **[Sirach 2:1-4](/bible/sirach/2#v1)** *[[0:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=46s)]* > [1](/bible/sirach/2#v1) My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation. > > [2](/bible/sirach/2#v2) Set thy heart aright, and constantly endure, and make not haste in time of trouble. > > [3](/bible/sirach/2#v3) Cleave unto him, and depart not away, that thou mayest be increased at thy last end. > > [4](/bible/sirach/2#v4) Whatsoever is brought upon thee take cheerfully, and be patient when thou art changed to a low estate. - Because this is a part of that temptation. Things happen. You go up, because promotion comes from the Lord anyway. You go up, you go down. It can be any number of reasons why you have gotten demoted. So you gotten demoted. What to do now? - My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation: that temptation could very well be a demotion. My son, when you come to serve the Lord, whatever temptation comes, whatever trial comes, is what the temptation is talking about. Whatever trial comes, you better prepare your spirit by fasting, prayer, getting around men, getting around whoever to get your spirit together. - Set thy heart aright, and constantly endure: constantly don't mean if this happen. It means constantly. It means don't matter what. - And make not haste in time of trouble: don't make haste if you're demoted. Don't get all in your feelings when you're demoted. And this class is for me too, cuz I don't know what's next week, tomorrow, the next day or whatever. But I pray that this class is ministering to me as well. So prepare your soul. - And be patient when thou art changed to a low estate. **[1 Samuel 18:1-5](/bible/1-samuel/18#v1)** *[[2:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=162s)]* > [1](/bible/1-samuel/18#v1) And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul. > > [2](/bible/1-samuel/18#v2) And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house. > > [3](/bible/1-samuel/18#v3) Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul. > > [4](/bible/1-samuel/18#v4) And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle. > > [5](/bible/1-samuel/18#v5) And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants. - Let's see what our forefather King David, which is one of my favorite. - That the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David: and this just after he killed Goliath the Philistine. So he's now with Saul and now with Jonathan. - And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house: so Saul is saying, you with me. You rolling with the king. - Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul: they were brothers to the end. Like, bro, you saved the kingdom. - And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David: imagine that. You got Saul, the King. Jonathan's the prince. Grown man is a prince. He takes off his princely robes and give it to a herder, a goat herder, sheep. So now this warrior is now walking around in an exalted state. He has on the prince stuff. He got his sword. He got his robe. He got his garment. He gave him his bow and his girdle. So he got a golden girdle. - And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: so that is saying David went wherever Saul went. So when Saul got there, you heard the king is here. You had the king and you had David, you had Jonathan. He was a part of the royal court. Imagine that, from a sheep herder to the royal court. And he say he behaved himself wisely and he was accepted. So now you go from being a sheep herder to now one of the most exalted men in the kingdom at this point. **[1 Samuel 18:7-9](/bible/1-samuel/18#v7)** *[[5:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=336s)]* > [7](/bible/1-samuel/18#v7) And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands. > > [8](/bible/1-samuel/18#v8) And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom? > > [9](/bible/1-samuel/18#v9) And Saul eyed David from that day and forward. - And Saul eyed David from that day and forward: so now, for doing what he's supposed to do, remember he's up here, he's in the royal court. Now David does what he's supposed to do, and it says that people accepted him and they loved him. And they was like, man, you see how David was swinging that sword? He didn't do it for vain glory. He did it because the power of God was on him. - That's like you brothers teaching out here and you get jealous because somebody can teach better than you. That's not in the spirit. That's what Saul was going through. Like, damn, this brother better than me. This brother teach like this. He remember all of those scriptures. But in this case, it was the king. He eyed him. **[1 Samuel 18:10](/bible/1-samuel/18#v10)** *[[6:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=417s)]* > [10](/bible/1-samuel/18#v10) And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul’s hand. - The evil spirit from God came upon Saul: so day one he's up here. The next day Saul is pissed and trying to kill him. **[1 Samuel 18:13-14](/bible/1-samuel/18#v13)** *[[7:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=436s)]* > [13](/bible/1-samuel/18#v13) Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people. > > [14](/bible/1-samuel/18#v14) And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the Lord was with him. - Y'all remember, demoted, what do you do? David at this point is exalted. Watch, he get demoted from verse 13. - Therefore Saul removed him from him: so now he's no longer part of the royal court. He's no longer a captain. He's no longer officer, no longer a deacon. I'm just using it in the terms that we use. He's now demoted to a soldier. That's not what he's demoted to, but you going to read it. - And made him his captain over a thousand: so in five he was over all men of war. And in verse 13 he was a captain of a thousand. He got promoted one day, demoted the next day to a captain of a thousand. - And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways: so even in David's demotion, David behaved himself wisely the same way he behaved himself when he was promoted to the royal court. When he was exalted, he behaved himself wisely. When he was demoted the next day to a captain of a thousand, he also behaved himself wisely. - And the LORD was with him: God deals with brothers that understand promotion comes from the Lord. Promotion is an order standard. But the work still right here. It says he behaved himself wisely. What did he do? He ordered those thousand men. I was over the whole military, now I'm over this little brigade right here. All right, this what we going to do when we go out to war, X, Y and Z. Brothers, make sure you're getting your swords ready. Make sure you sharpen your swords. Make sure y'all practice, man, because we going up to the Philistines. He's going back and forth as a captain of a thousand. - He did not let his demotion stop the work. And you sitting in the back with your lip dragging the damn floor. David did not even skip a beat, cuz he probably felt, I shouldn't have been here anyway. I'm a lowly servant. I was only doing what I was supposed to do for my nation. - A lot of us get into the mindset, no, I deserve something. All of our righteousness is but filthy rags. We don't deserve nothing. David is like, yo, I was comfortable and content. I just heard what this filthy behind Philistine said, and it made me pissed, and I wanted to fight, cuz who the hell is this Philistine that he bump his gums against our Lord? He gotta die. Boom. Killed him. I'm going right back with the sheep. It is what it is. But that's the mindset of David. I still got to do the work regardless. We should have that mindset. **[2 Corinthians 13:5](/bible/2-corinthians/13#v5)** *[[11:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=660s)]* > [5](/bible/2-corinthians/13#v5) Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates? - And if you don't have this mindset and you're not working on this mindset: Paul says, I've learned to abound and I learn to be abased. Wherever I am, I'm content. That's what David is doing. Wherever he is, he okay with it. - Now, should we be a screw up and get demoted and just say, ah, yeah, that's just a love of the Lord? No, that's not at all what I'm saying. Please don't get that from what I'm saying. Do what you supposed to do, and whatever happens happens. - Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves: you got to examine your spirit and prove. Can you withstand a demotion? Can you withstand coming from sitting up here in the leadership table to now on the front row? And if you can't withstand it, ask yourself why. Ask yourself, am I here just for the big plates? Am I just here for the big garments with all the gold and stuff on it? Am I here for the people to look up at me at the leadership table and have the chief seats in the congregation? Is that me? And it might be you. You might not can see yourself down there ever again. If you can't, check your spirit. Examine yourself. See whether you be in the faith. - Know ye not your own selves: you know what you battle and what you going through. - How that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates: and David had the spirit of Christ. Yes, this is before Christ, but he had the spirit of Christ in him. And that's why he wasn't a reprobate. That's why when he got demoted, he said, yo, I'mma behave myself wisely. I'mma go in and out amongst these thousand, and I'mma do what I'm supposed to do. And the Lord was with him. **[Psalms 75:6-8](/bible/psalms/75#v6)** *[[13:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=797s)]* > [6](/bible/psalms/75#v6) For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south. > > [7](/bible/psalms/75#v7) But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another. > > [8](/bible/psalms/75#v8) For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them. - For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south. But God is the judge: God is the judge. - He putteth down one, and setteth up another: not you and your own filthy rags righteousness. I should write that in class. Filthy rags righteousness. Sound good? Let me write that down. **[1 Corinthians 15:58](/bible/1-corinthians/15#v58)** *[[14:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=859s)]* > [58](/bible/1-corinthians/15#v58) Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord. - Be ye stedfast, unmoveable: unmovable. - Always abounding in the work of the Lord: always abounding, no matter what you are, where you are, what rank you have settled at right now. Always be immovable in the work of the Lord. Don't matter. As a soldier, pass the hell out some flyers. If you demoted from a captain to whatever, whatever that rank's responsibility is at camp, you should be doing it. If you up to teach, teach like nobody's business. It is what it is. - Stay in the spirit, because the long run, God is looking at all these things. Because when David got demoted, it says the Lord was with him. ## In Closing *[[15:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE&t=914s)]* Stay in the spirit, Israel. Wherever you are, stay in the spirit. --- [15 Minutes Index](/captains) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr-lfesaePE)
